thread:
Elena Kim: Quick announcement 6 heads-up: rolling out a preview of the On‑Prem Telemetry Redaction Toolkit for Private/VPC customers. Intended for customers who need to forward operational telemetry to our support tools without sending PII or raw prompt contents. Preview signup link at the bottom.

Mateo Garcia: TL;DR of what it does: "client-side filters + transform hooks" in the agent that run inside customer networks and redact/mask sensitive fields before anything leaves the VPC. Supports regex-based redaction, named-entity masking (PII heuristics), and custom JS transform hooks. All transforms run in a sandboxed Wasm runtime.

Elena Kim: Why this exists: we've had multiple enterprise asks for "send traces for debugging but never send prompts" and regulators asking for stronger egress controls. This toolkit formalizes that. Default behaviour is deny-by-default; customers opt-in to each telemetry stream.

Priya Shah: Pilot scope: 1) Redaction ruleset editor (UI + CLI), 2) Wasm transform plug-ins, 3) KMS-backed policy signing (so customers can sign approved rules), 4) minimal attestation fingerprints posted to the control plane (only rule hashes and delivery metadata). Not included in preview: automatic semantic PII classifiers trained on customer data; that's planned for GA.

SecurityBot: Security note: all rule evaluation happens locally. The agent only sends a signed rule-hash, delivery counts, and a short verdict (ok/blocked) if the customer enables attestations. No raw payloads are transmitted by default.

Mateo Garcia: Quick config example (agent YAML snippet to enable redaction and point to local rules):
```yaml
agent:
  telemetry:
    redaction:
      enabled: true
      rules_path: /etc/redaction/rules.yaml
      wasm_plugins:
        - /opt/agent/plugins/pii_masker.wasm
      attestations:
        enabled: true
        endpoint: https://controlplane.redwood.internal/attest
```

Elena Kim: Example rule file (rules.yaml):
```yaml
rules:
  - id: mask-cards
    match: '(?:\b\d{4}[- ]?\d{4}[- ]?\d{4}[- ]?\d{4}\b)'
    action: mask
    mask_char: 'X'
  - id: redact-emails
    match: '\\b[\\w.+-]+@[\\w.-]+\\.[a-zA-Z]{2,6}\\b'
    action: redact
```

Priya Shah: Operational notes: 1) We will ship a ruleset library customers can import, 2) Support will still be able to request ephemeral debug bundles (customer opt-in only), 3) we will provide an integration test harness so customers can validate rules locally.

Mateo Garcia: Deploy metadata: preview image `ghcr.io/redwood/agent:telemetry-redact-preview-2026-04-08` created by deploy-bot. Agent upgrade path is rolling and reversible; rules are versioned and signed.
